product: DataFrame caching on serverless compute is now in Public Preview
tagline: DataFrame caching on serverless compute is now in Public Preview.
what_it_does: DataFrame caching on serverless compute is now in Public Preview. You can cache a DataFrame with df.cache() or df.persist() on serverless compute to reuse an expensive result for the rest of your session. Caching requires serverless environment version 5 or above, Databricks Connect for Python 18.1.8 or above, or Databricks Connect for Scala 18.1.5 or above.
why_it_matters: The preview isn't available in workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled.
